title: ‘Let the aid in’: deadly winter approaches in Gaza – The Latest
byline: Lucy Hough; Emma Graham-Harrison; Angus Neale; Leonore Schick; Zoe Hitch
html:
‘Let the aid in’: deadly winter approaches in Gaza – The Latest

Deadly floods in Gaza have created a dire humanitarian crisis, as the governments of Australia, Canada, the UK and Italy call on Israel to allow the safe passage of critical aid to civilians before winter sets in. Tens of thousands of Palestinians in Gaza have been left in waterlogged and damaged tents, with sanitation infrastructure also destroyed by storms. Supplies including food, medicine and water and 150,000 tents are being held by Israel at the border, while the UN warns of the spread of diseases. Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s chief Middle East correspondent, Emma Graham-Harrison – watch on YouTube
